task_description: Fix the PJUD bot search flow that fails when clicking Buscar (returns 0 results and resets). The root cause is incorrect dropdown selection order and interaction pattern. Also fix 8 additional stability issues: BOT_MODE/BOT_MAX_CAUSAS env vars not read, hardcoded 10-detail limit, page.goBack() losing session, hardcoded years, screenshot paths, markCausaScraped never called, CHECK constraint violation on tipo field, and dead code.

verification.review_v2: APPROVED - all v1 issues addressed, 2 non-blocking observations remain
verification.summary: TypeScript compilation passes for all modified bot files. Only errors are pre-existing TS7006 (implicit any) in supabaseSync.ts and missing node_modules (TS2307/TS2591) which cannot be installed in INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network. No new errors introduced by our changes. Semantic review approved on v2.

fixes: Post-detail navigation now re-runs searchByYear for the current year so the results table is repopulated
Causas are grouped by year to efficiently re-search only the relevant year
BOT_MAX_DETAILS env var split from BOT_MAX_CAUSAS (separate discovery vs detail-scrape limits)
Poll timeout increased from 30s to 60s, configurable via BOT_POLL_TIMEOUT env var
Added log message when close-verification cannot determine dropdown state
RIT regex widened to support multi-letter prefixes (e.g. FA-123-2024)
Error recovery in detail loop attempts to restore navigation state before continuing
